resources.string: Choose fonts and sizes for keyboard text
Choose font files from your device. Schema choices apply as you switch Rime schemas.
Choose multiple fonts to fill missing characters in fallback order. Collection fonts use their first face. Unset choices inherit the global font.
On Android 6–9, only the first usable font in each list is used. Collection fonts use their first face. Unset choices inherit the global font.
Choose a local TTF, OTF, TTC or OTC file (up to 64 MiB)
Remove “%1$s” and clear its selections? The source file is kept.
Import a font file first, then select it here.
Tap a font to move it to the first position
Choose up to eight fonts per list
Enter a size from 8 to 72 sp
Aa Bb 123 · 中文候选 · あいう · 한글
Restore original fonts and sizes; keep imported files
Restore the original fonts and sizes for all keyboard text?
Choose a schema, then set its candidates, popup keys and preedit separately. Unset choices inherit the normal settings for that text area.
Use the normal fonts and sizes for this schema
Restore the normal font and size choices for %1$s?
For a schema that is not listed, enter its schema_id from the schema YAML file.
Use 1–128 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
